blogPosts.title: From Chatbots to Agentic AI: Why Goal-Oriented Multi-Agent Systems Win in 2026
blogPosts.excerpt: Why simple prompt wrappers fail enterprise SLAs and how self-correcting multi-agent architectures deliver verifiable outcomes.
blogPosts.content: As foundation models matured, the limitation of single-turn prompts became clear. Enterprise workflows require state persistence, tool calling, validation loops, and dynamic task delegation. Agentic AI shifts the paradigm from passive question-answering to proactive execution. At Coledra, we build agent ensembles with specialized planner, executor, and verifier roles that interface directly with enterprise ERPs and databases with strict guardrails.
blogPosts.author: Chief AI Architect, Coledra

blogPosts.title: Strategic Migration Roadmap: Transitioning Legacy Oracle EBS to OCI and Autonomous DB
blogPosts.excerpt: Step-by-step methodology for zero-data-loss lift and shift into Oracle Cloud Infrastructure with automated performance tuning.
blogPosts.content: Running mission-critical enterprise workloads on legacy on-premise hardware creates technical debt, licensing inflation, and maintenance hazards. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) combined with Autonomous Transaction Processing (ATP) delivers self-repairing, autoscaling databases. This article walks through Coledra's four-phase migration framework.
blogPosts.author: Principal Oracle Consultant, Coledra

blogPosts.title: Modern Identity Governance: Implementing Zero-Trust Privileged Access in Hybrid Clouds

blogPosts.content: Traditional network perimeters are obsolete. In modern multi-cloud architectures, Identity is the new perimeter. Learn how to architect a frictionless Zero-Trust posture with Okta, CyberArk, and continuous adaptive risk assessment.
